title: FMGE Test Series · FMGE Test Series Year 2022 · National Fmge Mock Test 2 Dec 2022

questions.stem: A mother of five, brings her youngest child, an 18-month-old girl, for evaluation. The child appears very thin with minimal fat distribution. There is severe wasting of the shoulders, arms, buttocks, and thighs as shown in the below image. The middle-upper arm circumference is less than 11.5cm. The child is alert and irritable. What is the likely diagnosis?
